family_name: Autex Willie Weston / Emma Hayes Quietspace

spec.description:
Autex Willie Weston / Emma Hayes Quietspace is a premium broadband acoustic
wall panel engineered with dual-density polyester construction and overlaid with
high-definition digital artwork from First Nations artists (Willie Weston) or
serene landscape designs (Emma Hayes). Built on a 25mm thick Quietspace Panel
base with an impact-resistant face and cushioned backing, it absorbs 85% of
sound energy (NRC 0.85). Digitally printed with water-based UV-cured ink, it
provides museum-grade cultural aesthetics with class-leading acoustic absorption
and Group 1 fire safety.

install:
Inspect wall
or ceiling substrate ensuring it is flat, clean, dry, and dust-free

Acclimatise panels in the installation environment for at least 24 hours prior
to fitting

Confirm image numbering and pattern alignment across the
multi-panel layout diagram

Handle panels with clean hands or white gloves to
protect the printed artwork surface

Apply recommended contact adhesive or
high-grab MS polymer adhesive evenly across the panel backing

Mount panel
squarely to the substrate and apply firm, even roller pressure across the face

Ensure adjacent panels are tightly butted to maintain continuous artistic
visuals

Trim edges squarely from the face using a sharp knife on the offcut
side where required
selection_checklist:
Select artwork design from
Willie Weston (First Nations) or Emma Hayes (NZ landscapes)

Confirm 25mm
Quietspace core for maximum sound absorption (NRC 0.85)

Confirm panel height
(2400mm, 2700mm, or 3000mm) x 1200mm width

Verify multi-panel mural sequence
and wall dimensions

Specify suitable adhesive and edge profile trims (Type C
profiles) if desired

High-grab MS polymer or contact adhesive
limitations:
Indoor use only; avoid wet areas or
direct water exposure

Printed decorative face can show marks under heavy
friction; avoid high-impact sporting zones

Do not bend or fold panels as this
will crack the high-density compressed face

retrieval.rag_summary:
Autex Willie
Weston / Emma Hayes Quietspace merges the class-leading sound absorption of 25mm
dual-density Quietspace Panel (NRC 0.85) with curated digital UV printing of
Australian First Nations art (Willie Weston) and New Zealand landscapes (Emma
Hayes). Using safe water-based inks directly on the compressed polyester face,
it eliminates room reverberation while functioning as a large-format cultural
art piece. Certified Group 1 fire rated under AS ISO 9705, carbon neutral, and
made with over 58% recycled PET, it offers an architecturally stunning,
high-performance acoustic wall finish.
